as_told.title: Green fireball seen with Lue Elizondo in Wyoming

plain: Michels says that in 2024, one night at the Wyoming home of Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon intelligence official who now speaks publicly about UFOs, he and Elizondo saw a green orb in the sky. Michels tells it first-hand, reminding Elizondo: "we saw a green orb with you, I don't know you remember that, it was night time." In a later episode he describes it as a green fireball that "just shoot out into the sky."
